label: De ente c.3 three stages composed: one first being whose esse is its essence; purity route connected
summary: Issue #1628. Materialized and read AQUINAS-DE-ENTE-C3-4 (Baur/Koch c.3 [69874] = Leonine c.4, English §§77–81). Reuse: #1629 step 457698e4 (mode-unspecified other actual cause), q.3 a.4 profile, existing reception premises 6dfe01ab/7fcfcee8/14325c83, root-purity route dcea77db and root-uniqueness route 0edb19eb. Results (zero-axiom): (b) at most one actual being whose esse is its essence (860eae63) from the sourced multiplication inventory (encoded only at pairs of beings whose esse is their essence), no-difference and no-matter readings, the reception premises (third mode) and the OPEN shared-nature premise 75b5b027 (#697 individuation gap); (c) every actual distinct esse descends through finite chains of actual causes of being from a being whose esse is its essence (0807e653), the reduction principle derived from 457698e4 and the OPEN well-foundedness premise fd12ad3d with excluded middle; (a)+(b)+(c) one such being has no actual cause of its esse and heads a chain of actual causes of being to every other actual being (5c904cf6, also using fd12ad3d), with unequal represented esse and essence for every other being derived from at-most-one in the passage's order, not from the intellectus-essentiae argument; (d) root-purity sibling e6337182 with 457698e4 in place of the q.3 a.4 pair, which makes the #1629 chain reach the root (frontier-diff 477 -> 480 open, 469 -> 473 support alternatives); at-most-one actual root c056ad5c. Controls 04212a3f: infinite regress, uncaused distinct esse, two sources (shared-nature premise omitted), nonvacuity. Rejected approaches: concluding 7ab0ddcb directly (type-checks, but the new argument fails the sense check because 5c898d24 and 7ab0ddcb carry INTRINSIC_PRODUCTIVE_CONTRIBUTION_VERSUS_SOURCE_BACKED_1/_2, legacy-allowlisted only); deriving the third-mode exclusion through the weak identity-scoped b9316115 (different Frame vocabulary, so 6dfe01ab is used with strong_version_needed); assuming the reduction principle as a premise (would be a transcription). Wippel's conceptual-to-real worry recorded as a targeted challenge and avoided by drawing the real distinction from stage (b). Provisional judgment in docs/notes/de-ente-esse-source-1628.md: valid with causal coverage of distinct esse, no infinite regress of actual causes of being and the shared-nature premise; strongest rival to existence is the global/infinite derivative order (price: account for the obtaining of the whole order's esse or accept it as brute), to uniqueness the two-sources account (price: a non-additive distinguisher of pure esses). No premise established; no efficiency, conservation, necessity or God identification.
